Yes I am using a saved R session. I am using an R script that has been

library(aroma.affymetrix)
verbose <- Arguments$getVerbose(-8, timestamp=TRUE)

## DEFINING ANNOTATION DATA ##

## Chip Definition File (CDF) - plots postions of the probes on the
array ##

chipType <- "HuGene-1_0-st-v1"
cdf <- AffymetrixCdfFile$fromChipType(chipType,tags="r3")
print (cdf)

cdfu <- getUniqueCdf(cdf,verbose=-80)
csQNU <- convertToUnique(csQN,verbose=-20)

## NetAffx CSV File - Probe Set Annotation File ##

csv <- AffymetrixNetAffxCsvFile$byChipType(chipType, tags=".hg18")
print(csv)

NFX <- read.csv('~/SimuGen/ProjectValium/annotationData/chipTypes/
HuGene-1_0-st-v1/HuGene-1_0-st-
v1.hg18.annot.csv',sep=',',skip=19,header=TRUE,comment.char="",stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

## Probe Tab File ##

probetab <- read.table('~/SimuGen/ProjectValium/annotationData/
chipTypes/HuGene-1_0-st-v1/HuGene-1_0-st-
v1.probe.tab.tab',sep="\t",header=TRUE,comment.char="",stringsAsFactors=FALSE)


### DEFINING RAW DATA ##

## Affymetrix Cel Files ##

cs <- AffymetrixCelSet$byName("main", cdf=cdf)
print(cs)

messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Re: Error in UseMethod("hasTag")
parts:
So most likely you had outdated aroma.affymetrix objects sitting
around from an earlier session.

FYI, from aroma.affymetrix's point of view it makes little sense to
store the session; everything is stored to file anyway.

/H
